summary: Magnitude International Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq Staff Delisting Determination dated August 3, 2026, following an SEC trading suspension (Dec 5–18, 2025) and Nasdaq halt (Dec 19, 2025). Nasdaq acted under Listing Rule IM-5101-4 over third-party manipulation concerns. The Singapore-based electrical engineering firm will request a hearings panel review, which stays delisting pending decision. No wrongdoing by the company was found. Trading halt remains. Watch for hearing outcome and potential OTC or other venue listing.
